description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Tommy Bahama is hiring an Associate Front End Web Developer to help build and maintain its B2C eCommerce experience. The role develops customer-facing features and integrations, supports campaigns and CMS content, and collaborates with creative, marketing, and development teams under senior developer guidance.
Associate Front-End Web Developer building Angular eCommerce features, integrating SAP OCC/CMS, and delivering responsive, accessible, SEO-focused experiences

Responsibilities:
• Develop front‑end features using the Angular framework, TypeScript/NgRx, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, translating creative designs into clean, working code for a B2C eCommerce platform, with guidance and code review from senior developers
• Integrate and consume SAP REST OCC APIs to support dynamic application functionality
• Build and maintain integrations with third‑party platforms including Adobe Dynamic Media, Google Maps, Bazaarvoice, Adobe Target, Adobe Experience Manager, Klaviyo, and others
• Support CMS‑driven site content and develop new CMS components, templates, and features
• Deliver a polished, pixel-perfect experience across every browser, platform, and viewport our customers use
• Develop and maintain responsive, mobile‑first website experiences optimized for phones, tablets, and desktops
• Implement SEO‑focused development practices for eCommerce, including SSR, structured data, canonical URLs, sitemaps, and an understanding of AEO/GEO considerations
• Execute time‑sensitive website updates such as promotional events, product launches, and seasonal campaigns
• Assist with gathering requirements and communicating with non‑technical stakeholders, with support from senior developers on more complex or ambiguous requests
• Troubleshoot and resolve straightforward usability, performance, and functional issues, escalating more complex problems to senior developers
• Team up with Creative to bring bold designs to life — building, implementing, and testing pages, interactive components, and UI enhancements customers will actually notice
• Stay curious about emerging web technologies and practices, and bring new ideas to the team for discussion
• Build and test UI components for WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility compliance, including semantic HTML, ARIA attributes, and screen reader compatibility
• Write and maintain automated unit and end-to-end tests (e.g., Jasmine/Karma, Cypress) to ensure code quality and prevent regressions
• Implement and maintain analytics and tag management integrations (e.g., Adobe Analytics/GA4, Adobe Launch/Google Tag Manager) to support site tracking and reporting
• Manage day-to-day tasks with guidance from the Lead Front End Web Developer and project management, prioritizing work as directed
• Actively participate in code reviews — both giving and receiving feedback — to build technical skills and absorb team coding standards and best practices

Requirements:
• 1–3 years of hands‑on web development experience
• Foundational knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript; exposure to Angular and TypeScript (through coursework, projects, or professional experience)
• Willingness to learn and apply WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility guidelines, automated testing frameworks (e.g., Jasmine/Karma, Cypress), and analytics/tag management tools (e.g., Adobe Analytics, GA4, Adobe Launch, Google Tag Manager)
• Ability to collaborate effectively with external vendors and internal business stakeholders
• Eagerness to learn, take feedback well, and grow into greater ownership of tasks and technical challenges over time
• Familiarity with IDEs such as **Eclipse** or **Visual Studio Code**

Preferred:
• NgRx, REST APIs, SCSS, Git, JSON, familiarity with a CMS platform such as Adobe Experience Manager, and interest in using AI‑assisted development tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT)
• prior exposure is a plus
• Exposure to designing, developing, or testing **B2C eCommerce** or other consumer-facing websites (preferred, not required)
• Familiarity with **CMS platforms or components** is a plus
• Working knowledge of relational databases (plus)
• Experience with **SAP Commerce Cloud Composable Framework** (plus)
